Roles or activities involved: IRL-01 / OPS-01; command versus hands-on containment
Scenario trigger: High provisional incident at 08:45 WAT with three IT personnel
Potential consequence: Delayed decisions, incomplete records, or an operator expanding scope while the Lead is occupied
Proposed mitigating control: Keep IRL-01 on command and decision logging; assign OPS-01 execution; appoint deputy or record delegation
Residual limitation: A small team may still require sequencing and external support
Verification method: Review staffing allocation and decision log during each material decision

Roles or activities involved: FOR-01 / OPS-01; evidence handling versus destructive containment
Scenario trigger: E06 file-impact indicators and possible continuing activity on FIN-PC07 or FS01
Potential consequence: Evidence may be altered or lost while urgent isolation is being considered
Proposed mitigating control: Preserve high-value records where safe; document unavoidable loss; separate evidence custody from technical execution; request specialist forensics when needed
Residual limitation: Volatile evidence may be unavailable before containment is necessary
Verification method: Check evidence references, preservation decisions, and custody records

Roles or activities involved: OPS-01 / SEC-01 / BKP-01; backup administration versus backup integrity validation
Scenario trigger: E03 privileged activity involving BAK01 and uncertain E05 backup trust
Potential consequence: A technically accessible backup could be treated as clean or recoverable without independent validation
Proposed mitigating control: Separate technical access from security validation; prohibit unvalidated restoration; involve BKP-01 only after approval
Residual limitation: Internal validation capability and provider availability are uncertain
Verification method: Review isolated validation evidence and approval gates before restoration

Roles or activities involved: OPS-01 / SEC-01 / M365-01; identity administration versus compromise investigation
Scenario trigger: E02 unfamiliar sign-in and E03 unusual privileged activity
Potential consequence: Account changes could destroy evidence or an investigator could delay protective action
Proposed mitigating control: Preserve sign-in, MFA, device, token, mailbox, and account-change records where safe; document identity action scope
Residual limitation: Provider-side records and identity expertise may be unavailable
Verification method: Compare identity actions with preserved audit records and evidence references

Roles or activities involved: COM-01 / LP-01 / MGT-01; communication drafting versus approval
Scenario trigger: E08 inaccessible contact list and unverified corporate email
Potential consequence: Inaccurate, premature, or overly sensitive information could be released
Proposed mitigating control: COM-01 drafts; LP-01 advises; MGT-01 approves material or external release; use verified phone fallback
Residual limitation: No confirmed secure collaboration platform or dedicated communications team
Verification method: Review message approval, channel verification, audience, and communication log

Roles or activities involved: OPS-01 / BSO-01 / SEC-01; recovery implementation versus business acceptance
Scenario trigger: E07 learner-facing disruption and 11:00 examination deadline
Potential consequence: Technical availability could be mistaken for safe or acceptable business service
Proposed mitigating control: Separate R14 technical work, R15 security validation, R16 data-integrity verification, and R17 business acceptance
Residual limitation: Time pressure may create conflicting recommendations
Verification method: Review all four recovery gates and the recorded acceptance decision

Roles or activities involved: SEC-01 / IRL-01; security analysis versus containment authority
Scenario trigger: E04 transfer activity and uncertain attacker or account attribution
Potential consequence: Analytical uncertainty could delay necessary action or be misread as approval to act
Proposed mitigating control: SEC-01 provides evidence and recommendations; IRL-01 owns normal containment; emergency path is separately constrained
Verification method: Check RACI assignments and decision records for separate analysis and authority
